Vik: quick heads-up from onboarding nebula-44k (int4). We have deterministic drift that only appears when prefill-interleave=host and rotary-rescale= fractional. float32/int16 baselines clean.
Hana: can you paste the repro command and quant tag?
Vik: repro: `./eval/long_prefill --model nebula-44k --quant int4 --context 46000 --prefill-interleave=host --prefetch-window 12288 --rotary-rescale=fractional --seed 21`
Luis: interesting combo. interleave=host + fractional rescale isn't something we've stress-tested. What's the failure signature?
Vik: token mismatch starts at ~43840. KV fingerprints show duplicate keys from different hosts with slightly different rope-phase metadata (phase delta ~0.0003) and later a key collision overwrites previous entry. snippet: `kv: dup key=0x7f8e abs_pos=43838 src=host0 phase=0.312001` then `kv: write key=0x7f8e abs_pos=43838 src=host1 phase=0.312301` then `token-check expected=token_43841 actual=token_43840`
Hana: fractional rescale computes a per-token float scale that we quantize into int metadata; tiny differences between hosts (due to kernel chunking/timing) could cause different quantized values and therefore different fingerprints for same logical abs_pos. When host1 overwrote host0 entry we lost canonical keys.
Luis: quick experiment: run with `--prefill-interleave=host --kv-salt=host-id` to include host in key derivation. if collisions stop it's a short-term mitigation. Also try `--rotary-rescale=integer` as control.
Vik: tried both: host-id salt eliminates collisions but changes downstream expected keys (so migration needed), integer rescale also avoids drift but reduces perplexity slightly. Uploaded logs and kv-dumps to s3://redwood-eval/nebula_prefill/2098765432.tar.gz
dev-bot: longprefill job queued (job id: lp-210900). baseline float32 pass. int4 reproduces 4/4 for interleave=host + fractional rescale.
Hana: action plan: 1) short-term: add host-id salt to key derivation and a compatibility migrate tool to reconcile existing keys 2) medium: tighten rotary rescale quantization so phase rounding is consistent across hosts (same quantization grid) 3) long-term: add invariant that rejects prefill writes when existing key phase differs > epsilon and logs full context.
Vik: I'll open PR for host-salt + migrate tool, run matrix PREFETCH_WINDOW {8192,12288}, KERNEL {scalar,vector}, RESCALE {fractional,integer} and post results. tagging INF-1844.
ops-bot: received canary request. reserving 3xA100 for team-ml on 2024-12-01T02:00Z-2024-12-01T03:30Z. ticket OP-8300 created.
Luis: also note to bisect if any recent quant changes adjusted phase packing precision. If the medium-term change is required, coordinate with model-onboard docs so customers know the migration semantics.
Vik: thanks. will update INF-1844 with triage and PR link. :rocket:
